research.summary: Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith faces Democrat Scott Colom, a north Mississippi district attorney, in a race WLBT says pundits now call increasingly competitive though most forecasters still rate it solid or likely Republican. Colom is running on rural hospitals, health care cuts and rising prices, while Hyde-Smith points to her record on infrastructure, tax relief and border security and has avoided debates.

issues.why: Colom says Medicaid cuts could close eight rural hospitals in a state that has not expanded Medicaid, and Harris attacked Hyde-Smith's vote for the cuts.

issues.issue: Prices, tariffs and the Iran war
issues.why: Colom calls Hyde-Smith Cindy High Prices and ties gas and grocery costs to tariffs and the Iran war.
Her campaign cites federal money for infrastructure and rural health care, tax relief, border security and conservative judges.
Hyde-Smith's ads label Colom a transgender defender, while Colom says he supports fairness in girls' sports and opposes gender surgery for minors.
Colom accuses Hyde-Smith of betraying farmers through support for tariffs.

storylines.title: Colom pulls AI ad after AG threat
storylines.what: Attorney General Lynn Fitch said Colom's unlabeled AI ad showing Hyde-Smith fleeing reporters likely broke state law. Colom agreed to delete it, calling it parody and accusing Republicans of weaponizing the justice system.

storylines.title: Harris rallies for Colom in Columbus
storylines.what: Kamala Harris campaigned with Colom and held a health care roundtable in Clarksdale, attacking Hyde-Smith's vote for Medicaid cuts.

storylines.title: Trump to rally in Corinth
storylines.what: Trump is set to campaign for Hyde-Smith in Corinth, as a Schumer aligned super PAC put 1.2 million dollars behind Colom. Hyde-Smith called the polls just noise and said Mississippi is pretty red.

storylines.title: Colom's viral homemade ad
storylines.what: Colom's Pick Another Senator ad, made cheaply in Mississippi, has drawn more than a million views, he says.

storylines.title: Poll touted by Colom was fabricated
storylines.what: Colom's campaign promoted a Wedgewood poll showing a near tie, and the firm later admitted it staged the poll to expose weak polling standards.

storylines.title: Colom calls Hyde-Smith chicken over debates
storylines.what: Colom accepted TV debate invitations and offered a third on her terms. Hyde-Smith's campaign said losing candidates always want a debate about debates.

events.title: Rural hospital closures
events.prompt: Medicaid cuts threaten several rural hospitals in a state that never expanded Medicaid. You are asked what you would do in Washington.

opts.label: Reverse the cuts
opts.say: Fight to reverse the Medicaid and ACA subsidy cuts that threaten hospitals.

opts.label: Rural hospital fund
opts.say: Push targeted federal money for rural hospitals without reopening the whole law.

opts.label: Defend the reforms
opts.say: Stand by the spending reforms and point to federal rural health dollars you secured.

events.title: AI ad complaint
events.prompt: The attorney general says an unlabeled AI campaign ad likely broke state election law and threatens an injunction 11 days before the election.

opts.label: Call it weaponization
opts.say: Pull the ad but accuse the other side of using the justice system for politics.

opts.label: Pull it quietly
opts.say: Delete the ad, label future content and move on to health care.

opts.label: Demand accountability
opts.say: Call for a full investigation and say voters were deceived.

events.title: Trump comes to Corinth
events.prompt: President Trump is coming to north Mississippi to rally for the Republican ticket as tariffs and the Iran war push up prices.

opts.label: Challenge Trump to debate
opts.say: Say the incumbent is scared and challenge the president himself to debate.

opts.label: Talk local costs
opts.say: Focus on gas, groceries and farm prices instead of the visit.

opts.label: Stand with Trump
opts.say: Welcome the president and say Mississippi stands with his agenda.

events.title: Debate invitations
events.prompt: Two TV stations have invited both candidates to debate and one side calls the other chicken for declining.

opts.label: Accept every debate
opts.say: Accept all invitations and offer a third debate on the opponent's terms.

opts.label: One debate
opts.say: Agree to a single televised debate.

opts.label: Run on the record
opts.say: Decline and say the record speaks for itself while the Senate is in session.

ads.theme: Pick Another Senator, a homemade spot urging voters to replace Hyde-Smith.
An AI depiction of Hyde-Smith running from reporters, later deleted.
A 1.2 million dollar late buy backing Colom.

regions.name: Jackson metro
regions.note: Majority Black Hinds is the Democratic anchor, offset by Republican suburban Rankin and Madison.

regions.name: Mississippi Delta
regions.note: Majority Black farm counties where Democrats need big turnout.

regions.name: North Mississippi
regions.note: Republican Memphis suburbs and Tupelo and Corinth, plus Colom's home base near Oxford.

regions.name: Golden Triangle
regions.note: Competitive area around Columbus and Starkville where Harris rallied.

regions.name: Gulf Coast
regions.note: Populous and strongly Republican coastal counties with shipbuilding and casinos.

regions.name: Pine Belt and Southwest
regions.note: Mostly Republican piney woods with Democratic pockets in Natchez and McComb.
